Under the direct supervision of the Assistant Director, Regulatory Unit, the Regulatory and Records Assistant (RRA) supports centralized regulatory and records-management activities for the UC Davis Comprehensive Cancer Center Office of Clinical Research (OCR). Responsibilities include processing IND safety reports and other routine regulatory activities; maintaining central essential documents and tracking required reviews, signatures, and training documentation; and coordinating the organization, retention, archival, and retrieval of clinical research records across OCR functional units. The RRA performs assigned activities in accordance with applicable regulations, institutional policies, OCR standard operating procedures, and established workflows.
35% - IND Safety Report Processing
35% - OCR-Wide Records Retention and Archiving
25% - Centralized Regulatory and Essential Document Support
5% - Quality, Systems, and Operational Support

Ability to provide timely, courteous, and service-oriented support while maintaining established compliance and documentation requirements.
